descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
We are looking for an experienced Business Intelligence Developer with strong SQL, PL/SQL, and Power BI skills to support data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence initiatives. The ideal candidate will be responsible for transforming data into meaningful insights, developing interactive dashboards, and collaborating with business stakeholders to deliver effective reporting solutions.
Responsibilities 
Develop, optimize, and maintain SQL and PL/SQL queries to support reporting and data analysis requirements.
Analyze, prepare, transform, and model data for business intelligence and reporting purposes.
Design, develop, and maintain interactive reports, dashboards, and KPI analyses using Power BI.
Create and optimize DAX calculations, measures, and business metrics.
Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into effective reporting and BI solutions.
Collaborate with business departments to identify relevant data, define KPIs, and visualize insights that support decision-making.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and performance of reports and dashboards.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and business intelligence solutions.
 Requirements 
Extensive experience working with SQL and/or PL/SQL, including query development and optimization.
Strong proficiency in Power BI, with hands-on experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
Solid knowledge of DAX for creating calculations, measures, and KPIs.
Previous experience working in a Business Intelligence environment.
Understanding of data analysis, data modeling, and reporting concepts.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact effectively with business stakeholders.
Fluency in both German and English.
 Nice to Have 
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
Experience with JasperReports.
Familiarity with GitLab and version control practices.
Knowledge of Angular.
Familiarity with Node.js.
